lock.title: Locked
lock.passcodeHint: Uses your iPhone passcode if Face ID isn’t available.
lock.cancelError: Unlock cancelled. Try again when you’re ready.
lock.authError: Couldn’t confirm it’s you. Try again.
lock.openError: Couldn’t open this home. Try again, or restore a backup in Settings.
lock.tip: The lock comes back after you leave the app. It keeps the house private if you hand the phone over.
recovery.titleMismatch: We can’t open this home on this iPhone
recovery.titleGeneric: We can’t open this home right now
recovery.bodyMismatch: This copy of your home needs a backup file from Settings, or you can erase and start over. Cuidala never had a server copy.
recovery.bodyUnavailable: Something on this iPhone blocked reading your home. Try again, restore a backup, or erase and start over.
recovery.bodyCorrupt: The saved home on this iPhone looks damaged. Nothing was overwritten. Restore a backup, or erase and start over.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Everything stays on this iPhone.
settings.languageHelp: App language. Dates follow this choice; budget stays in US dollars.
settings.zipHelp: Used for Apple Weather and which seasonal jobs apply here.
settings.digestHelp: A weekly nudge when something needs ordering.
settings.privateNotifTitle: Hide item names on the lock screen
settings.privateNotifHelp: Titles and details stay generic. Open the app to see names.
settings.notifDenied: Notifications are off for Cuidala in iOS Settings. Turn them on there to get reminders.
settings.notifPrompt: Turn the reminder on to allow notifications when something needs ordering.
settings.lockHelpOn: Locks when you leave the app. Face ID or your passcode unlocks the home on this iPhone.
settings.lockHelpOff: Not available on this device. Face ID, Touch ID, or a passcode must be set up in iOS Settings.
settings.yourDataBody: Your home stays on this iPhone. Moving to a new phone needs a backup file from below — Cuidala cannot reset a forgotten backup password.
settings.advancedHelp: Erase removes this home and its unlock key from this iPhone. Deleting the app also removes your home here.
settings.eraseAll: Erase all data on this iPhone
settings.eraseBody: Rooms, chores, items, history, and reminders on this iPhone will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
today.emptyCalendar: Nothing is due on this day. Daily chores show on their weekday. Seasonal jobs show in their window.
today.emptyToday: Nothing is due today. Daily chores show on their weekday. Seasonal jobs show in their window. Restock items show when it is time to order.
today.allClearAria: All clear. Nothing due, nothing to order
today.monthNone: Nothing scheduled for this month yet.
today.trackSupplyBody: We’ll remind you when to order so it arrives before you run out.
